claim: Per-condition fail rate reproduces across runs; patched-mode split and Fisher p-value do not.

fisher_variance.reading: Three orders of magnitude across reruns at temp 0. Fail rate is stable; mode split and p-value are not.

verdict_rule: PASS if fail rate identical across runs AND mode split varies.
reading: Fail rates reproduce exactly (test baseline 10/10, test patched 10/10). Mode split varies (6:4, 1:9, 6:4). Rule 9 introduces a stochastic second failure mode.
paper_action: sec 4.1 mode split labeled as single-sample; sec 4.3b added on p-value variance.
